decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core heat-exchanger business that gained its own page by 2024, it fits strongly with the firm's existing knowledge base and can be improved through ongoing engineering, testing and customer feedback.

This product is highly related to the firm's established condenser expertise and the stronger 2024 website presentation suggests sufficient commercial traction to justify continued refinement rather than withdrawal.
The tube liner builds on the firm's service and repair capabilities, so its absorptive capacity for learning and incremental improvement is high even if it appears to be a more niche offering.

A customized industrial air cooler line is very close to the firm's installed-base business and supports its solutions strategy, making it a sensible product to retain while adapting models to customer demand.

These repair inserts leverage the firm's installed equipment knowledge and lifecycle-service strengths, so despite likely narrower volume they are worth keeping as a complementary aftermarket product.
